none: PAS NLM-B55F25: Roman Coin: Radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Victorinus (269-271), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Bust radiate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]INVS[--]. Reverse description: Standing stick figure left, possibly with spear in hand and resting on shield, possibly Virtus. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 3 no. 11185 as a comparator. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 1.95gms, die axis: 6
